0100001112223331021320302 - ASI: 22

Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  01 = 0 * 1
  02 = 0 * 2
  03 = 0 * 3
  11 = 1 * 1
  22 = 2 * 2
  32 = 3 * 2
  33 = 3 * 3
  102 = 1 * 02
  111 = 1 * 11
  132 = 1 * 32
  222 = 2 * 22
  333 = 3 * 33
  0000 = 00 * 00
  0302 = 03 * 02
  010000 = 01 * 0000
  111222 = 111 * 222
  333102 = 333 * 102
  1320302 = 132 * 0302
  010000111222 = 010000 * 111222
  3331021320302 = 333102 * 1320302
  0100001112223331021320302 = 010000111222 * 3331021320302
